verses.textZh: 耶稣基督的仆人和使徒西门．彼得，写信给那靠着我们的神和救主耶稣基督的义，得着和我们同样宝贵信心的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督的仆人和使徒西门．彼得，写信给那靠着我们的神和救主耶稣基督的义，得着和我们同样宝贵信心的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 作耶稣基督仆人和使徒的西门‧彼得写信给那因我们的神和 救主耶稣基督之义、与我们同得一样宝贵信心的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
verses.textEnEsv: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have obtained a faith of equal standing with ours by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter, a bondservant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have obtained like precious faith with us by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Simon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ. I am writing to you who share the same precious faith we have. This faith was given to you because of the justice and fairness of Jesus Christ, our God and Savior.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter, a bond-servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have received a faith of the same kind as ours, by the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
verses.textEn: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安，因你们确实认识神和我们的主耶稣，多多加给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安，因你们确实认识神和我们的主耶稣，多多加给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安，因你们认识神和我们主耶稣，多多地加给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: May grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: May God give you more and more grace and peace as you grow in your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.textEn: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 神以他神圣的能力，因着我们确实认识那位用自己的荣耀和美善呼召我们的，把一切有关生命和敬虔的事，都赐给了我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神以他神圣的能力，因着我们确实认识那位用自己的荣耀和美善呼召我们的，把一切有关生命和敬虔的事，都赐给了我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的神能已将一切关乎生命和虔敬的事赐给我们，皆因我们认识那用自己荣耀和美德召我们的主。
verses.textEnNiv: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.
verses.textEnEsv: His divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us to his own glory and excellence,
verses.textEnNkjv: as His divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who called us by glory and virtue,
verses.textEnNlt: By his divine power, God has given us everything we need for living a godly life. We have received all of this by coming to know him, the one who called us to himself by means of his marvelous glory and excellence.
verses.textEnNasb: for His divine power has granted to us everything pertaining to life and godliness, through the true knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
verses.textEn: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.

verses.textZh: 借着这些，他把又宝贵又极大的应许赐给了我们，好叫你们既然逃脱世上因私欲而来的败坏，就可以分享神的本性。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着这些，他把又宝贵又极大的应许赐给了我们，好叫你们既然逃脱世上因私欲而来的败坏，就可以分享神的本性。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，他已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫我们既脱离世上从情欲来的败坏，就得与神的性情有分。
verses.textEnNiv: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
verses.textEnEsv: by which he has granted to us his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world because of sinful desire.
verses.textEnNkjv: by which have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, that through these you may be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption thatis in the world through lust.
verses.textEnNlt: And because of his glory and excellence, he has given us great and precious promises. These are the promises that enable you to share his divine nature and escape the world’s corruption caused by human desires.
verses.textEnNasb: Through these He has granted to us His precious and magnificent promises, so that by them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world on account of lust.
verses.textEn: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

verses.textZh: 正因这缘故，你们要多多努力：有了信心，又要增添美德；有了美德，又要增添知识；
verses.textZhCnvs: 正因这缘故，你们要多多努力：有了信心，又要增添美德；有了美德，又要增添知识；
verses.textZhCuv: 正因这缘故，你们要分外地殷勤；有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知识；
verses.textEnNiv: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;
verses.textEnEsv: For this very reason, make every effort to supplement your faith with virtue, and virtue with knowledge,
verses.textEnNkjv: But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge,
verses.textEnNlt: In view of all this, make every effort to respond to God’s promises. Supplement your faith with a generous provision of moral excellence, and moral excellence with knowledge,
verses.textEnNasb: Now for this very reason also, applying all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence, and in your moral excellence, knowledge,
verses.textEn: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;

verses.textZh: 有了知识，又要增添节制；有了节制，又要增添忍耐；有了忍耐，又要增添敬虔；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有了知识，又要增添节制；有了节制，又要增添忍耐；有了忍耐，又要增添敬虔；
verses.textZhCuv: 有了知识，又要加上节制；有了节制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；
verses.textEnNiv: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
verses.textEnEsv: and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with steadfastness, and steadfastness with godliness,
verses.textEnNkjv: to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness,
verses.textEnNlt: and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with patient endurance, and patient endurance with godliness,
verses.textEnNasb: and in your knowledge, self-control, and in your self-control, perseverance, and in your perseverance, godliness,
verses.textEn: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;

verses.textZh: 有了敬虔，又要增添弟兄的爱；有了弟兄的爱，还要增添神圣的爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有了敬虔，又要增添弟兄的爱；有了弟兄的爱，还要增添神圣的爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 有了虔敬，又要加上爱弟兄的心；有了爱弟兄的心，又要加上爱众人的心。
verses.textEnNiv: and to godliness, mutual affection; and to mutual affection, love.
verses.textEnEsv: and godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love.
verses.textEnNkjv: to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love.
verses.textEnNlt: and godliness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with love for everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: and in your godliness, brotherly kindness, and in your brotherly kindness, love.
verses.textEn: and to godliness, mutual affection; and to mutual affection, love.

verses.textZh: 因为你们有了这几样，并且继续增长，就必叫你们在确实认识我们的主耶稣基督上，不至于闲懒不结果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们有了这几样，并且继续增长，就必叫你们在确实认识我们的主耶稣基督上，不至于闲懒不结果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若充充足足地有这几样，就必使你们在认识我们的主耶稣基督上不至于闲懒不结果子了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: The more you grow like this, the more productive and useful you will be in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they do not make you useless nor unproductive in the true knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 人若没有这几样，就是近视，简直是瞎眼的，忘记他过去的罪已经得了洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若没有这几样，就是近视，简直是瞎眼的，忘记他过去的罪已经得了洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若没有这几样，就是眼瞎，只看见近处的，忘了他旧日的罪已经得了洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever does not have them is nearsighted and blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their past sins.
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever lacks these qualities is so nearsighted that he is blind, having forgotten that he was cleansed from his former sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who lacks these things is shortsighted, even to blindness, and has forgotten that he was cleansed from his old sins.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who fail to develop in this way are shortsighted or blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their old sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who lacks these qualities is blind or short-sighted, having forgotten his purification from his former sins.
verses.textEn: But whoever does not have them is nearsighted and blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their past sins.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，要更加努力，使你们所蒙的呼召和拣选坚定不移；你们若实行这几样，就决不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，要更加努力，使你们所蒙的呼召和拣选坚定不移；你们若实行这几样，就决不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以弟兄们，应当更加殷勤，使你们所蒙的恩召和拣选坚定不移。你们若行这几样，就永不失脚；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, brothers, be all the more diligent to confirm your calling and election, for if you practice these qualities you will never fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, be even more diligent to make your call and election sure, for if you do these things you will never stumble;
verses.textEnNlt: So, dear brothers and sisters, work hard to prove that you really are among those God has called and chosen. Do these things, and you will never fall away.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, brothers and sisters, be all the more diligent to make certain about His calling and choice of you; for as long as you practice these things, you will never stumble;
verses.textEn: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble,

verses.textZh: 这样，你们就得着充分的装备，可以进入我们的主和救主耶稣基督永远的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们就得着充分的装备，可以进入我们的主和救主耶稣基督永远的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，必叫你们丰丰富富地得以进入我们主－救主耶稣基督永远的国。
verses.textEnNiv: and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For in this way there will be richly provided for you an entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: for so an entrance will be supplied to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God will give you a grand entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: for in this way the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be abundantly supplied to you.
verses.textEn: and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们虽然已经知道这些事，又在你们已有的真道上得到坚固，我还要时常提醒你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们虽然已经知道这些事，又在你们已有的真道上得到坚固，我还要时常提醒你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们虽然晓得这些事，并且在你们已有的真道上坚固，我却要将这些事常常提醒你们。
verses.textEnNiv: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I intend always to remind you of these qualities, though you know them and are established in the truth that you have.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason I will not be negligent to remind you always of these things, though you know and are established in the present truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I will always remind you about these things—even though you already know them and are standing firm in the truth you have been taught.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I will always be ready to remind you of these things, even though you already know them and have been established in the truth which is present with you.
verses.textEn: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.

verses.textZh: 趁着我还在世上 的时候，我认为应当提醒你们，使你们常常警醒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 趁着我还在世上 的时候，我认为应当提醒你们，使你们常常警醒，
verses.textZhCuv: 我以为应当趁我还在这帐棚的时候提醒你们，激发你们；
verses.textEnNiv: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,
verses.textEnEsv: I think it right, as long as I am in this body, to stir you up by way of reminder,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I think it is right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
verses.textEnNlt: And it is only right that I should keep on reminding you as long as I live.
verses.textEnNasb: I consider it right, as long as I am in this earthly dwelling, to stir you up by way of reminder,
verses.textEn: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,

verses.textZh: 因为我知道我离世 的时候快到了，正如我们的主耶稣基督清楚指示我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道我离世 的时候快到了，正如我们的主耶稣基督清楚指示我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为知道我脱离这帐棚的时候快到了，正如我们主耶稣基督所指示我的。
verses.textEnNiv: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
verses.textEnEsv: since I know that the putting off of my body will be soon, as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that shortly I must put off my tent, just as our Lord Jesus Christ showed me.
verses.textEnNlt: For our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me that I must soon leave this earthly life,
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that the laying aside of my earthly dwelling is imminent, as also our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
verses.textEn: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

verses.textZh: 我也要努力，使你们在我去世以后，还时常追念这些事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要努力，使你们在我去世以后，还时常追念这些事。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且，我要尽心竭力，使你们在我去世以后时常记念这些事。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make every effort so that after my departure you may be able at any time to recall these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will be careful to ensure that you always have a reminder of these things after my decease.
verses.textEnNlt: so I will work hard to make sure you always remember these things after I am gone.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will also be diligent that at any time after my departure you will be able to call these things to mind.
verses.textEn: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.

verses.textZh: 我们从前把我们主耶稣基督的大能和降临的事告诉你们，并不是随从巧妙捏造传奇的故事，我们却是亲眼看见过他威荣的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前把我们主耶稣基督的大能和降临的事告诉你们，并不是随从巧妙捏造传奇的故事，我们却是亲眼看见过他威荣的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从前将我们主耶稣基督的大能和他降临的事告诉你们，并不是随从乖巧捏造的虚言，乃是亲眼见过他的威荣。
verses.textEnNiv: For we did not follow cleverly devised stories when we told you about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ in power, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: For we did not follow cleverly devised myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
verses.textEnNlt: For we were not making up clever stories when we told you about the powerful coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We saw his majestic splendor with our own eyes
verses.textEnNasb: For we did not follow cleverly devised tales when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
verses.textEn: For we did not follow cleverly devised stories when we told you about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ in power, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

verses.textZh: 因为他从父神得着尊贵荣耀的时候，在极显赫的荣光中，有这样的声音对他说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他从父神得着尊贵荣耀的时候，在极显赫的荣光中，有这样的声音对他说："这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他从父神得尊贵荣耀的时候，从极大荣光之中有声音出来，向他说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."
verses.textEnEsv: For when he received honor and glory from God the Father, and the voice was borne to him by the Majestic Glory, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased,"
verses.textEnNkjv: For He received from God the Father honor and glory when such a voice came to Him from the Excellent Glory: "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNlt: when he received honor and glory from God the Father. The voice from the majestic glory of God said to him, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy."
verses.textEnNasb: For when He received honor and glory from God the Father, such a declaration as this was made to Him by the Majestic Glory: "This is My beloved Son with whom I am well pleased"—
verses.textEn: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

verses.textZh: 这从天上发出来的声音，是我们和他同在圣山上的时候，亲自听见过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这从天上发出来的声音，是我们和他同在圣山上的时候，亲自听见过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们同他在圣山的时候，亲自听见这声音从天上出来。
verses.textEnNiv: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: we ourselves heard this very voice borne from heaven, for we were with him on the holy mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we heard this voice which came from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: We ourselves heard that voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: and we ourselves heard this declaration made from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
verses.textEn: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.

verses.textZh: 我们还有先知的话，是更确实的。你们要特别注意它，好象注意照在暗处的明灯，直到天将破晓，晨星在你们心里出现的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们还有先知的话，是更确实的。你们要特别注意它，好象注意照在暗处的明灯，直到天将破晓，晨星在你们心里出现的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们并有先知更确的预言，如同灯照在暗处。你们在这预言上留意，直等到天发亮，晨星在你们心里出现的时候，才是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: We also have the prophetic message as something completely reliable, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: And we have the prophetic word more fully confirmed, to which you will do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts,
verses.textEnNkjv: And so we have the prophetic word confirmed, which you do well to heed as a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts;
verses.textEnNlt: Because of that experience, we have even greater confidence in the message proclaimed by the prophets. You must pay close attention to what they wrote, for their words are like a lamp shining in a dark place—until the Day dawns, and Christ the Morning Star shines in your hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: And so we have the prophetic word made more sure, to which you do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts.
verses.textEn: We also have the prophetic message as something completely reliable, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

verses.textZh: 最要紧的，你们应当知道：圣经所有的预言，都不是先知自己的见解，
verses.textZhCnvs: 最要紧的，你们应当知道：圣经所有的预言，都不是先知自己的见解，
verses.textZhCuv: 第一要紧的，该知道经上所有的预言没有可随私意解说的；
verses.textEnNiv: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet’s own interpretation of things.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture comes from someone’s own interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of any private interpretation,
verses.textEnNlt: Above all, you must realize that no prophecy in Scripture ever came from the prophet’s own understanding,
verses.textEnNasb: But know this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture becomes a matter of someone’s own interpretation,
verses.textEn: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet’s own interpretation of things.

verses.textZh: 因为预言不是出于人意的，而是人受圣灵的感动，说出从神而来的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为预言不是出于人意的，而是人受圣灵的感动，说出从神而来的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为预言从来没有出于人意的，乃是人被圣灵感动，说出神的话来。
verses.textEnNiv: For prophecy never had its origin in the human will, but prophets, though human, spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: For no prophecy was ever produced by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: for prophecy never came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke astheywere moved by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: or from human initiative. No, those prophets were moved by the Holy Spirit, and they spoke from God.
verses.textEnNasb: for no prophecy was ever made by an act of human will, but men moved by the Holy Spirit spoke from God.
verses.textEn: For prophecy never had its origin in the human will, but prophets, though human, spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 从前在人民中，曾有假先知出来；照样，将来在你们中间，也必有假教师出现。他们偷偷把使人灭亡的异端引进来，甚至否认那曾经买赎他们的主，迅速地自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前在人民中，曾有假先知出来；照样，将来在你们中间，也必有假教师出现。他们偷偷把使人灭亡的异端引进来，甚至否认那曾经买赎他们的主，迅速地自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前在百姓中有假先知起来，将来在你们中间也必有假师傅，私自引进陷害人的异端，连买他们的主他们也不承认，自取速速地灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there were also false prophets among the people, even as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Lord who bought them, and bring on themselves swift destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: But there were also false prophets in Israel, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will cleverly teach destructive heresies and even deny the Master who bought them. In this way, they will bring sudden destruction on themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: But false prophets also appeared among the people, just as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing swift destruction upon themselves.
verses.textEn: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.

verses.textZh: 许多人会随从他们的淫行，因此真理的道，就因他们的缘故被人毁谤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人会随从他们的淫行，因此真理的道，就因他们的缘故被人毁谤。
verses.textZhCuv: 将有许多人随从他们邪淫的行为，便叫真道因他们的缘故被毁谤。
verses.textEnNiv: Many will follow their depraved conduct and will bring the way of truth into disrepute.
verses.textEnEsv: And many will follow their sensuality, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many will follow their destructive ways, because of whom the way of truth will be blasphemed.
verses.textEnNlt: Many will follow their evil teaching and shameful immorality. And because of these teachers, the way of truth will be slandered.
verses.textEnNasb: Many will follow their indecent behavior, and because of them the way of the truth will be maligned;
verses.textEn: Many will follow their depraved conduct and will bring the way of truth into disrepute.

verses.textZh: 他们因为有贪心，就用捏造的话，想在你们身上图利；惩罚他们的，自古以来就没有松懈；毁灭他们的，也不会打盹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因为有贪心，就用捏造的话，想在你们身上图利；惩罚他们的，自古以来就没有松懈；毁灭他们的，也不会打盹。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因有贪心，要用捏造的言语在你们身上取利。他们的刑罚，自古以来并不迟延；他们的灭亡也必速速来到 。
verses.textEnNiv: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with fabricated stories. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.
verses.textEnEsv: And in their greed they will exploit you with false words. Their condemnation from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: By covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words; for a long time their judgment has not been idle, and their destruction does not slumber.
verses.textEnNlt: In their greed they will make up clever lies to get hold of your money. But God condemned them long ago, and their destruction will not be delayed.
verses.textEnNasb: and in their greed they will exploit you with false words; their judgment from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.
verses.textEn: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with fabricated stories. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.

verses.textZh: 神没有姑息犯罪的天使，反而把他们丢入地狱，囚禁在幽暗的坑里，等候审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神没有姑息犯罪的天使，反而把他们丢入地狱，囚禁在幽暗的坑里，等候审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是天使犯了罪，神也没有宽容，曾把他们丢在地狱，交在黑暗坑中，等候审判。
verses.textEnNiv: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
verses.textEnEsv: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into hell and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until the judgment;
verses.textEnNkjv: For if God did not spare the angels who sinned, but cast them down to hell and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved for judgment;
verses.textEnNlt: For God did not spare even the angels who sinned. He threw them into hell, in gloomy pits of darkness, where they are being held until the day of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into hell and committed them to pits of darkness, held for judgment;
verses.textEn: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;

verses.textZh: 神也没有姑息上古的世界，反而使洪水临到那不敬虔的世人，只保存了传义道的挪亚一家八口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神也没有姑息上古的世界，反而使洪水临到那不敬虔的世人，只保存了传义道的挪亚一家八口。
verses.textZhCuv: 神也没有宽容上古的世代，曾叫洪水临到那不敬虔的世代，却保护了传义道的挪亚一家八口。
verses.textEnNiv: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;
verses.textEnEsv: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.textEnNkjv: and did not spare the ancient world, but saved Noah, oneof eight people, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood on the world of the ungodly;
verses.textEnNlt: And God did not spare the ancient world—except for Noah and the seven others in his family. Noah warned the world of God’s righteous judgment. So God protected Noah when he destroyed the world of ungodly people with a vast flood.
verses.textEnNasb: and did not spare the ancient world, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, with seven others, when He brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.textEn: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;

verses.textZh: 神判定了所多玛、蛾摩拉二城的罪，把它们倾覆，烧成灰烬，作为后世不敬虔的人的鉴戒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神判定了所多玛、蛾摩拉二城的罪，把它们倾覆，烧成灰烬，作为后世不敬虔的人的鉴戒；
verses.textZhCuv: 又判定所多玛、蛾摩拉，将二城倾覆，焚烧成灰，作为后世不敬虔人的鉴戒；
verses.textEnNiv: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;
verses.textEnEsv: if by turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes he condemned them to extinction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;
verses.textEnNkjv: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, making them an example to those who afterward would live ungodly;
verses.textEnNlt: Later, God condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and turned them into heaps of ashes. He made them an example of what will happen to ungodly people.
verses.textEnNasb: and if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction by reducing them to ashes, having made them an example of what is coming for the ungodly;
verses.textEn: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;

verses.textZh: 只救了那因恶人的淫行而常受委屈的义人罗得；
verses.textZhCnvs: 只救了那因恶人的淫行而常受委屈的义人罗得；
verses.textZhCuv: 只搭救了那常为恶人淫行忧伤的义人罗得。（
verses.textEnNiv: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
verses.textEnEsv: and if he rescued righteous Lot, greatly distressed by the sensual conduct of the wicked
verses.textEnNkjv: and delivered righteous Lot, whowas oppressed by the filthy conduct of the wicked
verses.textEnNlt: But God also rescued Lot out of Sodom because he was a righteous man who was sick of the shameful immorality of the wicked people around him.
verses.textEnNasb: and if He rescued righteous Lot, who was oppressed by the perverted conduct of unscrupulous people
verses.textEn: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless

verses.textZh: 主知道怎样搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，又把不义的人留下来，等候在审判的日子受刑罚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 主知道怎样搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，又把不义的人留下来，等候在审判的日子受刑罚，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那义人住在他们中间，看见听见他们不法的事，他的义心就天天伤痛。）
verses.textEnNiv: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
verses.textEnEsv: (for as that righteous man lived among them day after day, he was tormenting his righteous soul over their lawless deeds that he saw and heard);
verses.textEnNkjv: (for that righteous man, dwelling among them, tormented his righteous soul from day to day by seeing and hearing their lawless deeds)—
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, Lot was a righteous man who was tormented in his soul by the wickedness he saw and heard day after day.
verses.textEnNasb: (for by what he saw and heard that righteous man, while living among them, felt his righteous soul tormented day after day by their lawless deeds),
verses.textEn: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—

verses.textZh: 尤其是那些随从肉体，生活在污秽的私欲中，和轻蔑当权的，更是这样。他们胆大任性，毫无畏惧地毁谤在尊位的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尤其是那些随从肉体，生活在污秽的私欲中，和轻蔑当权的，更是这样。他们胆大任性，毫无畏惧地毁谤在尊位的。
verses.textZhCuv: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，把不义的人留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
verses.textEnNkjv: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptations and to reserve the unjust under punishment for the day of judgment,
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their trials, even while keeping the wicked under punishment until the day of final judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from a trial, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
verses.textEn: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.

verses.textZh: 就是天使，虽有更大的力量与权能，尚且不用毁谤的话在主面前控告他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是天使，虽有更大的力量与权能，尚且不用毁谤的话在主面前控告他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些随肉身、纵污秽的情欲、轻慢主治之人的，更是如此。 他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的，也不知惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to heap abuse on celestial beings;
verses.textEnEsv: and especially those who indulge in the lust of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they do not tremble as they blaspheme the glorious ones,
verses.textEnNkjv: and especially those who walk according to the flesh in the lust of uncleanness and despise authority. Theyare presumptuous, self-willed. They are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
verses.textEnNlt: He is especially hard on those who follow their own twisted sexual desire, and who despise authority. These people are proud and arrogant, daring even to scoff at supernatural beings without so much as trembling.
verses.textEnNasb: and especially those who indulge the flesh in its corrupt passion, and despise authority. Reckless, self-centered, they speak abusively of angelic majesties without trembling,
verses.textEn: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to heap abuse on celestial beings;

verses.textZh: 但这些人，好象没有理性的牲畜，生下来就是给人捉去宰杀的；他们毁谤自己所不知道的事，必在自己的败坏中灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这些人，好象没有理性的牲畜，生下来就是给人捉去宰杀的；他们毁谤自己所不知道的事，必在自己的败坏中灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是天使，虽然力量权能更大，还不用毁谤的话在主面前告他们。
verses.textEnNiv: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not heap abuse on such beings when bringing judgment on them from the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not pronounce a blasphemous judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: whereas angels, who are greater in power and might, do not bring a reviling accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But the angels, who are far greater in power and strength, do not dare to bring from the Lord a charge of blasphemy against those supernatural beings.
verses.textEnNasb: whereas angels who are greater in might and power do not bring a demeaning judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.textEn: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not heap abuse on such beings when bringing judgment on them from the Lord.

verses.textZh: 他们行不义，就得了不义的工价。他们在白昼纵情作乐，满了污点与瑕疵，和你们一同吃饭的时候，就因自己的诡诈而沾沾自喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们行不义，就得了不义的工价。他们在白昼纵情作乐，满了污点与瑕疵，和你们一同吃饭的时候，就因自己的诡诈而沾沾自喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这些人好像没有灵性，生来就是畜类，以备捉拿宰杀的。他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭遇败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: But these people blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like animals they too will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: But these, like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed, blaspheming about matters of which they are ignorant, will also be destroyed in their destruction,
verses.textEnNkjv: But these, like natural brute beasts made to be caught and destroyed, speak evil of the things they do not understand, and will utterly perish in their own corruption,
verses.textEnNlt: These false teachers are like unthinking animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed. They scoff at things they do not understand, and like animals, they will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: But these, like unreasoning animals, born as creatures of instinct to be captured and killed, using abusive speech where they have no knowledge, will in the destruction of those creatures also be destroyed,
verses.textEn: But these people blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like animals they too will perish.

verses.textZh: 他们满眼淫色，而且不住地犯罪。他们引诱心志不坚固的人。他们的心习惯了贪婪，是应当受咒诅的族类。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们满眼淫色，而且不住地犯罪。他们引诱心志不坚固的人。他们的心习惯了贪婪，是应当受咒诅的族类。
verses.textZhCuv: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价。这些人喜爱白昼宴乐，他们已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正与你们一同坐席，就以自己的诡诈为快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.
verses.textEnEsv: suffering wrong as the wage for their wrongdoing. They count it pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions, while they feast with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and will receive the wages of unrighteousness, as those who count it pleasure to carouse in the daytime. Theyare spots and blemishes, carousing in their own deceptions while they feast with you,
verses.textEnNlt: Their destruction is their reward for the harm they have done. They love to indulge in evil pleasures in broad daylight. They are a disgrace and a stain among you. They delight in deception even as they eat with you in your fellowship meals.
verses.textEnNasb: suffering wrong as the wages of doing wrong. They count it a pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions as they feast with you,
verses.textEn: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.

verses.textZh: 他们离弃正路，走入歧途，跟从了比珥的儿子巴兰的道路。这巴兰贪爱不义的工价，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离弃正路，走入歧途，跟从了比珥的儿子巴兰的道路。这巴兰贪爱不义的工价，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们满眼是淫色 ，止不住犯罪，引诱那心不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，正是被咒诅的种类。
verses.textEnNiv: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed—an accursed brood!
verses.textEnEsv: They have eyes full of adultery, insatiable for sin. They entice unsteady souls. They have hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!
verses.textEnNkjv: having eyes full of adultery and that cannot cease from sin, enticing unstable souls. They have a heart trained in covetous practices, andare accursed children.
verses.textEnNlt: They commit adultery with their eyes, and their desire for sin is never satisfied. They lure unstable people into sin, and they are well trained in greed. They live under God’s curse.
verses.textEnNasb: having eyes full of adultery that never cease from sin, enticing unstable souls, having hearts trained in greed, accursed children;
verses.textEn: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed—an accursed brood!

verses.textZh: 他曾经因着自己的过犯受了责备：不能说话的驴，竟用人的声音说出话来，制止了这先知的狂妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他曾经因着自己的过犯受了责备：不能说话的驴，竟用人的声音说出话来，制止了这先知的狂妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离弃正路，就走差了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路。巴兰就是那贪爱不义之工价的先知，
verses.textEnNiv: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Bezer, who loved the wages of wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: Forsaking the right way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,
verses.textEnNkjv: They have forsaken the right way and gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.textEnNlt: They have wandered off the right road and followed the footsteps of Balaam son of Beor, who loved to earn money by doing wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: abandoning the right way, they have gone astray, having followed the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the reward of unrighteousness;
verses.textEn: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Bezer, who loved the wages of wickedness.

verses.textZh: 这些人是无水的泉源，是暴风催逼的雾气，有漆黑的幽暗为他们存留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人是无水的泉源，是暴风催逼的雾气，有漆黑的幽暗为他们存留。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却为自己的过犯受了责备；那不能说话的驴以人言拦阻先知的狂妄。
verses.textEnNiv: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey—an animal without speech—who spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
verses.textEnEsv: but was rebuked for his own transgression; a speechless donkey spoke with human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
verses.textEnNkjv: but he was rebuked for his iniquity: a dumb donkey speaking with a man’s voice restrained the madness of the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: But Balaam was stopped from his mad course when his donkey rebuked him with a human voice.
verses.textEnNasb: but he received a rebuke for his own offense, for a mute donkey, speaking with a human voice, restrained the insanity of the prophet.
verses.textEn: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey—an animal without speech—who spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

verses.textZh: 因为他们说虚妄夸大的话，用肉体的私欲和邪荡的事，引诱那些刚刚逃脱了错谬生活的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们说虚妄夸大的话，用肉体的私欲和邪荡的事，引诱那些刚刚逃脱了错谬生活的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人是无水的井，是狂风催逼的雾气，有墨黑的幽暗为他们存留。
verses.textEnNiv: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
verses.textEnEsv: These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm. For them the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are wells without water, clouds carried by a tempest, for whom is reserved the blackness of darkness forever.
verses.textEnNlt: These people are as useless as dried-up springs or as mist blown away by the wind. They are doomed to blackest darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: These are springs without water and mists driven by a storm, for whom the black darkness has been reserved.
verses.textEn: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

verses.textZh: 他们应许给人自由，自己却作了败坏的奴仆；因为人给谁制伏了，就作谁的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们应许给人自由，自己却作了败坏的奴仆；因为人给谁制伏了，就作谁的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，用肉身的情欲和邪淫的事引诱那些刚才脱离妄行的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of the flesh, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.
verses.textEnEsv: For, speaking loud boasts of folly, they entice by sensual passions of the flesh those who are barely escaping from those who live in error.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when they speak great swelling words of emptiness, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through lewdness, the ones who have actually escaped from those who live in error.
verses.textEnNlt: They brag about themselves with empty, foolish boasting. With an appeal to twisted sexual desires, they lure back into sin those who have barely escaped from a lifestyle of deception.
verses.textEnNasb: For, while speaking out arrogant words of no value they entice by fleshly desires, by indecent behavior, those who barely escape from the ones who live in error,
verses.textEn: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of the flesh, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.

verses.textZh: 如果他们因为认识我们的主、救主耶稣基督，可以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住、受制伏，他们末了的景况，就比先前的更不好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们因为认识我们的主、救主耶稣基督，可以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住、受制伏，他们末了的景况，就比先前的更不好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们应许人得以自由，自己却作败坏的奴仆，因为人被谁制伏就是谁的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity—for "people are slaves to whatever has mastered them."
verses.textEnEsv: They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.
verses.textEnNkjv: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by whom a person is overcome, by him also he is brought into bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: They promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of sin and corruption. For you are a slave to whatever controls you.
verses.textEnNasb: promising them freedom while they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by what anyone is overcome, by this he is enslaved.
verses.textEn: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity—for "people are slaves to whatever has mastered them."

verses.textZh: 既然认识了义路，竟又背弃传给他们的圣诫命，对他们来说，倒不如不认识好得多了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然认识了义路，竟又背弃传给他们的圣诫命，对他们来说，倒不如不认识好得多了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若他们因认识主－救主耶稣基督，得以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住、制伏，他们末后的景况就比先前更不好了。
verses.textEnNiv: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and are overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.
verses.textEnEsv: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if, after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the latter end is worse for them than the beginning.
verses.textEnNlt: And when people escape from the wickedness of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and then get tangled up and enslaved by sin again, they are worse off than before.
verses.textEnNasb: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and are overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
verses.textEn: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and are overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.

verses.textZh: 他们的情形，正像俗语所说的： "狗转过来，又吃自己所吐的； 猪洗净了，又到污泥中去打滚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的情形，正像俗语所说的： "狗转过来，又吃自己所吐的； 猪洗净了，又到污泥中去打滚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们晓得义路，竟背弃了传给他们的圣命，倒不如不晓得为妙。
verses.textEnNiv: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.
verses.textEnEsv: For it would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than after knowing it to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than having known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered to them.
verses.textEnNlt: It would be better if they had never known the way to righteousness than to know it and then reject the command they were given to live a holy life.
verses.textEnNasb: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than having known it, to turn away from the holy commandment handed on to them.
verses.textEn: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.

verses.textZh: 俗语说得真不错： 狗所吐的，它转过来又吃； 猪洗净了又回到泥里去滚； 这话在他们身上正合式。
verses.textZhCnvs: 俗语说得真不错： 狗所吐的，它转过来又吃； 猪洗净了又回到泥里去滚； 这话在他们身上正合式。
verses.textZhCuv: 俗语说得真不错： 狗所吐的，它转过来又吃； 猪洗净了又回到泥里去滚； 这话在他们身上正合式。
verses.textEnNiv: Of them the proverbs are true: "A dog returns to its vomit," and, "A sow that is washed returns to her wallowing in the mud."
verses.textEnEsv: What the true proverb says has happened to them: "The dog returns to its own vomit, and the sow, after washing herself, returns to wallow in the mire."
verses.textEnNkjv: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb: "A dog returns to his own vomit," and, "a sow, having washed, to her wallowing in the mire."
verses.textEnNlt: They prove the truth of this proverb: "A dog returns to its vomit." And another says, "A washed pig returns to the mud."
verses.textEnNasb: It has happened to them according to the true proverb, "A dog returns to its own vomit," and, "A sow, after washing, returns to wallowing in the mire."
verses.textEn: Of them the proverbs are true: "A dog returns to its vomit," and, "A sow that is washed returns to her wallowing in the mud."

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我现在写给你们的是第二封信。在这两封信中，我都用提醒的话来激发你们真诚的心，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我现在写给你们的是第二封信。在这两封信中，我都用提醒的话来激发你们真诚的心，
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我现在写给你们的是第二封信。这两封都是提醒你们，激发你们诚实的心，
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.
verses.textEnEsv: This is now the second letter that I am writing to you, beloved. In both of them I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder,
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, I now write to you this second epistle (in bothof which I stir up your pure minds by way of reminder),
verses.textEnNlt: This is my second letter to you, dear friends, and in both of them I have tried to stimulate your wholesome thinking and refresh your memory.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you in which I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of a reminder,
verses.textEn: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.

verses.textZh: 叫你们记起圣先知说过的话，和主救主借着使徒传给你们的诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫你们记起圣先知说过的话，和主救主借着使徒传给你们的诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们记念圣先知预先所说的话和主救主的命令，就是使徒所传给你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
verses.textEnEsv: that you should remember the predictions of the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to remember what the holy prophets said long ago and what our Lord and Savior commanded through your apostles.
verses.textEnNasb: to remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior spoken by your apostles.
verses.textEn: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

verses.textZh: 最重要的，你们应当知道：在末后的日子，必定有好讥笑的人出来，随着自己的私欲讥笑说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 最重要的，你们应当知道：在末后的日子，必定有好讥笑的人出来，随着自己的私欲讥笑说：
verses.textZhCuv: 第一要紧的，该知道在末世必有好讥诮的人随从自己的私欲出来讥诮说：
verses.textEnNiv: Above all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing this first of all, that scoffers will come in the last days with scoffing, following their own sinful desires.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing this first: that scoffers will come in the last days, walking according to their own lusts,
verses.textEnNlt: Most importantly, I want to remind you that in the last days scoffers will come, mocking the truth and following their own desires.
verses.textEnNasb: Know this first of all, that in the last days mockers will come with their mocking, following after their own lusts,
verses.textEn: Above all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

verses.textZh: "他要降临的应许在哪里呢？因为自从列祖睡了以来，万物依然存在，与起初创造的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "他要降临的应许在哪里呢？因为自从列祖睡了以来，万物依然存在，与起初创造的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「主要降临的应许在哪里呢？因为从列祖睡了以来，万物与起初创造的时候仍是一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will say, "Where is this ‘coming’ he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation."
verses.textEnEsv: They will say, "Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things are continuing as they were from the beginning of creation."
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "Where is the promise of His coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as theywere from the beginning of creation."
verses.textEnNlt: They will say, "What happened to the promise that Jesus is coming again? From before the times of our ancestors, everything has remained the same since the world was first created."
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, "Where is the promise of His coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue just as they were from the beginning of creation."
verses.textEn: They will say, "Where is this ‘coming’ he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation."

verses.textZh: 他们故意忘记这事：在太古的时候，因着神的话，就有了天，和从水而出、藉水而成的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们故意忘记这事：在太古的时候，因着神的话，就有了天，和从水而出、藉水而成的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们故意忘记，从太古，凭神的命有了天，并从水而出、藉水而成的地。
verses.textEnNiv: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God’s word the heavens came into being and the earth was formed out of water and by water.
verses.textEnEsv: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: For this they willfully forget: that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of water and in the water,
verses.textEnNlt: They deliberately forget that God made the heavens long ago by the word of his command, and he brought the earth out from the water and surrounded it with water.
verses.textEnNasb: For when they maintain this, it escapes their notice that by the word of God the heavens existed long ago and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
verses.textEn: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God’s word the heavens came into being and the earth was formed out of water and by water.

verses.textZh: 当时的世界，因被水淹没而消灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时的世界，因被水淹没而消灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，当时的世界被水淹没就消灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: by which the world that then existed perished, being flooded with water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he used the water to destroy the ancient world with a mighty flood.
verses.textEnNasb: through which the world at that time was destroyed by being flooded with water.
verses.textEn: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.

verses.textZh: 但现在的天地，还是因着同样的话可以存留，直到不敬虔的人受审判和遭灭亡的日子，用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在的天地，还是因着同样的话可以存留，直到不敬虔的人受审判和遭灭亡的日子，用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在的天地还是凭着那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受审判遭沉沦的日子，用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.
verses.textEnEsv: But by the same word the heavens and earth that now exist are stored up for fire, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the heavens and the earth which are now preserved by the same word, are reserved for fire until the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.textEnNlt: And by the same word, the present heavens and earth have been stored up for fire. They are being kept for the day of judgment, when ungodly people will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: But by His word the present heavens and earth are being reserved for fire, kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.
verses.textEn: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，这一件事你们不可忘记：在主看来，一日如千年，千年如一日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，这一件事你们不可忘记：在主看来，一日如千年，千年如一日。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，有一件事你们不可忘记，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。
verses.textEnNiv: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
verses.textEnEsv: But do not overlook this one fact, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, beloved, do not forget this one thing, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not forget this one thing, dear friends: A day is like a thousand years to the Lord, and a thousand years is like a day.
verses.textEnNasb: But do not let this one fact escape your notice, beloved, that with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
verses.textEn: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

verses.textZh: 主决不耽延他的应许，像有些人以为他是耽延的一样；其实他是宽容你们，不愿有一人灭亡，却愿人人都悔改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主决不耽延他的应许，像有些人以为他是耽延的一样；其实他是宽容你们，不愿有一人灭亡，却愿人人都悔改。
verses.textZhCuv: 主所应许的尚未成就，有人以为他是耽延，其实不是耽延，乃是宽容你们，不愿有一人沉沦，乃愿人人都悔改。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promise as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is not slack concerning His promise, as some count slackness, but is longsuffering toward us, not willing that any should perish but that all should come to repentance.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord isn’t really being slow about his promise, as some people think. No, he is being patient for your sake. He does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants everyone to repent.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is not slow about His promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not willing for any to perish, but for all to come to repentance.
verses.textEn: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

verses.textZh: 但主的日子必要像贼一样来到。在那日，天必轰然一声地消失，所有元素都因烈火而融化；地和地上所有的，都要被烧毁 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但主的日子必要像贼一样来到。在那日，天必轰然一声地消失，所有元素都因烈火而融化；地和地上所有的，都要被烧毁 。
verses.textZhCuv: 但主的日子要像贼来到一样。那日，天必大有响声废去，有形质的都要被烈火销化，地和其上的物都要烧尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be laid bare.
verses.textEnEsv: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the heavenly bodies will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will melt with fervent heat; both the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
verses.textEnNlt: But the day of the Lord will come as unexpectedly as a thief. Then the heavens will pass away with a terrible noise, and the very elements themselves will disappear in fire, and the earth and everything on it will be found to deserve judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar and the elements will be destroyed with intense heat, and the earth and its works will be discovered.
verses.textEn: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be laid bare.

verses.textZh: 这一切既然都要这样融化，你们应当怎样为人，过着圣洁和敬虔的生活，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切既然都要这样融化，你们应当怎样为人，过着圣洁和敬虔的生活，
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切既然都要如此销化，你们为人该当怎样圣洁，怎样敬虔，
verses.textEnNiv: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives
verses.textEnEsv: Since all these things are thus to be dissolved, what sort of people ought you to be in lives of holiness and godliness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since all these things will be dissolved, what manner ofpersons ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,
verses.textEnNlt: Since everything around us is going to be destroyed like this, what holy and godly lives you should live,
verses.textEnNasb: Since all these things are to be destroyed in this way, what sort of people ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,
verses.textEn: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives

verses.textZh: 等候并催促神的日子降临呢？因为在那日，天要被火焚烧就融化了，所有元素都因烈火而融解！
verses.textZhCnvs: 等候并催促神的日子降临呢？因为在那日，天要被火焚烧就融化了，所有元素都因烈火而融解！
verses.textZhCuv: 切切仰望神的日子来到。在那日，天被火烧就销化了，有形质的都要被烈火熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.
verses.textEnEsv: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the heavenly bodies will melt as they burn!
verses.textEnNkjv: looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be dissolved, being on fire, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
verses.textEnNlt: looking forward to the day of God and hurrying it along. On that day, he will set the heavens on fire, and the elements will melt away in the flames.
verses.textEnNasb: looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be destroyed by burning, and the elements will melt with intense heat!
verses.textEn: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.

verses.textZh: 但是我们按照他所应许的，等候新天新地，有公义在那里居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我们按照他所应许的，等候新天新地，有公义在那里居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们照他的应许，盼望新天新地，有义居在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
verses.textEnEsv: But according to his promise we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless we, according to His promise, look for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.
verses.textEnNlt: But we are looking forward to the new heavens and new earth he has promised, a world filled with God’s righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: But according to His promise we are looking for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
verses.textEn: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

verses.textZh: 所以，亲爱的，你们既然等候这些事，就当殷勤努力，使你们没有污点，没有瑕疵，安然见主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，亲爱的，你们既然等候这些事，就当殷勤努力，使你们没有污点，没有瑕疵，安然见主。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们既盼望这些事，就当殷勤，使自己没有玷污，无可指摘，安然见主；
verses.textEnNiv: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, beloved, since you are waiting for these, be diligent to be found by him without spot or blemish, and at peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, beloved, looking forward to these things, be diligent to be found by Him in peace, without spot and blameless;
verses.textEnNlt: And so, dear friends, while you are waiting for these things to happen, make every effort to be found living peaceful lives that are pure and blameless in his sight.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, beloved, since you look for these things, be diligent to be found spotless and blameless by Him, at peace,
verses.textEn: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.

verses.textZh: 并且要以我们的主恒久忍耐为给人得救的机会，就如我们所亲爱的弟兄保罗，按照所赐给他的智慧，写给你们的一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要以我们的主恒久忍耐为给人得救的机会，就如我们所亲爱的弟兄保罗，按照所赐给他的智慧，写给你们的一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且要以我主长久忍耐为得救的因由，就如我们所亲爱的兄弟保罗，照着所赐给他的智慧写了信给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Bear in mind that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.
verses.textEnEsv: And count the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,
verses.textEnNkjv: and consider that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation—as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him, has written to you,
verses.textEnNlt: And remember, our Lord’s patience gives people time to be saved. This is what our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him—
verses.textEnNasb: and regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; just as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given him, wrote to you,
verses.textEn: Bear in mind that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.

verses.textZh: 他在一切书信上，都讲论这些事。在这些书信中，有些难明白的地方，那不学无术和不稳定的人加以曲解，好象曲解别的经书一样，就自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在一切书信上，都讲论这些事。在这些书信中，有些难明白的地方，那不学无术和不稳定的人加以曲解，好象曲解别的经书一样，就自取灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一切的信上也都是讲论这事。信中有些难明白的，那无学问、不坚固的人强解，如强解别的经书一样，就自取沉沦。
verses.textEnNiv: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.
verses.textEnNkjv: as also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things, in which are some things hard to understand, which untaught and unstable people twist to their own destruction, as theydo also the rest of the Scriptures.
verses.textEnNlt: speaking of these things in all of his letters. Some of his comments are hard to understand, and those who are ignorant and unstable have twisted his letters to mean something quite different, just as they do with other parts of Scripture. And this will result in their destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: as also in all his letters, speaking in them of these things, in which there are some things that are hard to understand, which the untaught and unstable distort, as they do also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
verses.textEn: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

verses.textZh: 所以，亲爱的，你们既然预先知道了，就要谨慎，免得受恶人的错谬引导，就从自己坚固的地步上坠落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，亲爱的，你们既然预先知道了，就要谨慎，免得受恶人的错谬引导，就从自己坚固的地步上坠落。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们既然预先知道这事，就当防备，恐怕被恶人的错谬诱惑，就从自己坚固的地步上坠落。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, dear friends, since you have been forewarned, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure position.
verses.textEnEsv: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, take care that you are not carried away with the error of lawless people and lose your own stability.
verses.textEnNkjv: You therefore, beloved, since you know this beforehand, beware lest you also fall from your own steadfastness, being led away with the error of the wicked;
verses.textEnNlt: You already know these things, dear friends. So be on guard; then you will not be carried away by the errors of these wicked people and lose your own secure footing.
verses.textEnNasb: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, be on your guard so that you are not carried away by the error of unscrupulous people and lose your own firm commitment,
verses.textEn: Therefore, dear friends, since you have been forewarned, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure position.

verses.textZh: 你们却要在我们的主、救主耶稣基督的恩典和知识上长进。愿荣耀归给他，从现在直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却要在我们的主、救主耶稣基督的恩典和知识上长进。愿荣耀归给他，从现在直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却要在我们主－救主耶稣基督的恩典和知识上有长进。愿荣耀归给他，从今直到永远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, you must grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. All glory to him, both now and forever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory, both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
verses.textEn: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.
